 Live .  29,804 viewing 29804 viewing Live page Updated 2 minutes ago Google outage hits websites and apps as some bank customers report issues
 Summary
 Google says "multiple" Cloud services are suffering network failures 
 "We are experiencing an issue with multiple services in europe-west2", the company says, adding that issues began around 07:00 BST
 The company adds its "engineering team continues to investigate the issue"
 Online bank Revolut, delivery service DPD and Royal Mail are among the businesses reporting issues, according to Downdetector - here are some others 
 Thousands of Revolut customers have experienced problems making payments and accessing funds
 Meanwhile, in a post on X, Halifax says it's "aware some customers are having issues" with its app and website
 Live Reporting
 Edited by Sam Hancock and Caitlin Doherty
 Delivery firm DPD 'aware of connection issues' published at 12:04 BST 12:04 BST 
 Delivery firm DPD is among the firms experiencing issues, according to reporting site Downdetector.
 In a statement on its Irish twitter account, DPD said earlier: "We are aware of current connection issues affecting our website. 
 "Our team is working to get this resolved as quickly as possible. We apologise for any inconvenience caused."
 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Lloyds bank reports some customers having issues published at 11:53 BST 11:53 BST 
 Earlier, Lloyds bank told the BBC its app was functioning normally, but added "we understand some are having issues with certain online services this morning". 
 "We are aware of similar issues affecting other organisations and are monitoring the situation closely."
 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Google Cloud outage - what do we know? published at 11:42 BST 11:42 BST 
 Google Cloud says that "multiple services" are experiencing issues
 A number of firms appear to have problems, with reports of outages on the Downdetector platform showing upticks throughout Tuesday morning
 Online bank Revolut has been reporting "service disruption" but says that customers' "money and data are safe" 
 Halifax bank also says it is "aware some customers are having issues" with its app and website, while the delivery firm DPD is also reporting website issues
 In a statement on its Cloud status platform, Google says it will provide its next update by 12:00 BST
 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Emma budgeting app says 'this is not a security issue' published at 11:19 BST 11:19 BST 
 Emma, a UK-based budgeting app, also says its services are down.
 "Emma is currently down due to a Google Cloud outage affecting services in London since 7am. 
 "This is a technical outage, not a security issue.
 "We're monitoring closely and will update here as soon as the app is back. Sorry for the disruption."
 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Halifax 'aware some customers are having issues' published at 11:18 BST 11:18 BST 
 In a post on X, Halifax says it is "aware some customers are having issues" with their app and website.
 "We're sorry about this and are working hard to fix it. If you need to you can still call us. We’ll let you know as soon as it’s back to normal," the bank tells a customer on X.
 The bank did not confirm whether the issues were caused by the Google Cloud problems.
 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Revolut reports 'service disruption' - but says 'money and data are safe' published at 11:16 BST 11:16 BST 
 Earlier this morning, Revolut, the online British bank, reported a "service disruption affecting multiple services".
 Thousands of customers have reported problems.
 "We can confirm that all our customers’ money and data are safe," it said.
 "We’ve been working to fix the issue since it was identified this morning and apologise to anyone affected and for any inconvenience caused."
 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Revolut and DPD among businesses reporting issues published at 11:16 BST 11:16 BST 
 The website Downdetector - which collates reported issues with web programmes- is showing an uptick in issues across a number of websites on Tuesday morning.
 It is not known if all companies listed are users of Google Cloud services. 
 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Experiencing an issue with multiple services,' says Google Cloud published at 11:06 BST 11:06 BST 
 In a message shared on its Cloud Status page, Google says: "We are experiencing an issue with multiple services in europe-west2", and says that the issues began around 07:00 BST (23:08 PDT).
 "Our engineering team continues to investigate the issue." 
 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Google reports issues with 'multiple' Cloud services published at 11:01 BST 11:01 BST Breaking 
 Google says that "multiple" Cloud services have been suffering network failures. 
 It comes as users of the bank Revolut have been reporting outages. 
 This is a breaking news story - we'll bring you updates as we get them. 
 Image source, Google Image caption, An error message shown on the Google Cloud website a short time ago
